//: A minimal Gatehouse configuration, annotated. Pass it with:
Every setting here can also come from an environment variable using the
Keys beginning with // are comments. JSON has none, and .NET configuration
ignores unrecognised keys, so this is the least surprising convention available.

Store.//: SQLite is the default and needs no external database. WAL mode is enabled automatically.

//: Prefer ApiKeyEnvironmentVariable over a literal ApiKey. A key written into a
config file ends up in git history, in container images, and in every backup
of both. Gatehouse logs a warning at startup if you use the literal form.

ollama.//: Local models need no credential at all.

//: The key is what callers put in the 'model' field. Keeping it separate from the
upstream name is what lets you move traffic between providers without any

gpt-4o-mini.//: Alias and upstream model match, so UpstreamModel can be omitted.

fast.//: A capability name. Repoint this at a different model or provider at will.
